// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-registration: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface AggregateCopyContext extends AggregateReplicaContext {
    direction: 'source' | 'target';
}

export interface AggregateReplicaContext {
    spaceId: string;
    conflictState?: import('./sync-transport.js').SyncConflictState;
    authorize(): void;
    canUploadProject(projectId: string): boolean;
    project(projectId: string): {
        title: string;
    };
    hasReference?(projectId: string, reference: {
        owner: 'goals' | 'artifacts';
        assetId: string;
        version?: number;
    }): boolean;
    hasArtifact(projectId: string, id: string, version: number): boolean;
}

export type BuiltinSyncBinding = ({
    readonly content?: (context: {
        spaceId: string;
        authorize(): void;
    }) => SyncContentCodec;
    readonly scope: 'home' | 'home-with-projects' | 'projects';
    open(home: string, ownerId: string): {
        close(): void;
        replica(context: AggregateReplicaContext): SyncReplicaAdapter;
    };
} | {
    readonly content?: (context: {
        spaceId: string;
        authorize(): void;
    }) => SyncContentCodec;
    readonly scope: 'home-store';
    readonly path: string;
    readonly owner: string;
} | {
    readonly content?: (context: {
        spaceId: string;
        authorize(): void;
    }) => SyncContentCodec;
    readonly scope: 'project-fixed-versions';
    readonly store: 'library' | 'process';
} | {
    readonly content?: (context: {
        spaceId: string;
        authorize(): void;
    }) => SyncContentCodec;
    readonly scope: 'home-document';
    readonly path: string;
    open(home: string, context: {
        spaceId: string;
        storage: SyncDocumentStorage;
        authorize(): void;
    }): SyncReplicaAdapter;
} | {
    readonly content?: (context: {
        spaceId: string;
        authorize(): void;
    }) => SyncContentCodec;
    readonly scope: 'project-database';
    readonly kind: string;
    install?(db: ReplicaDatabase, projectId: string): void;
    create(db: ReplicaDatabase, context: {
        spaceId: string;
        projectId: string;
        title: string;
        authorize(): void;
    }): SyncReplicaAdapter;
} | {
    readonly content?: (context: {
        spaceId: string;
        authorize(): void;
    }) => SyncContentCodec;
    readonly scope: 'project-sections';
    readonly kind: string;
    readonly namespace: string;
    readonly owners: readonly ProjectSyncContentOwner[];
} | {
    readonly content?: (context: {
        spaceId: string;
        authorize(): void;
    }) => SyncContentCodec;
    readonly scope: 'project-private-values';
    readonly kind: string;
    readonly namespace: string;
    owner(options: {
        home?: string;
        authorize?(): void;
        verifyDistribution?: PluginDistributionVerifier;
        assertIdle?(projectId: string, itemId: string): void;
    }): PrivateValueReplicationOwner;
} | {
    readonly content?: (context: {
        spaceId: string;
        authorize(): void;
    }) => SyncContentCodec;
    readonly scope: 'project-library';
    readonly kind: string;
    open(home: string, projectId: string): {
        close(): void;
        replica(context: {
            spaceId: string;
            projectId: string;
            title: string;
            authorize(): void;
        }): SyncReplicaAdapter;
    };
}) & {
    readonly copy?: (home: string, context: AggregateCopyContext) => {
        owner: import('../services/placement.js').ProjectCopyOwner;
        close(): void;
    } | null;
    readonly locate?: (key: string) => string | null;
};

export interface PluginBoardSpecimen {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly place: "column" | "page";
    readonly html: string;
}

export interface PluginBoardSpecimenPorts {
    escape(value: unknown): string;
    text(value: string, values?: Record<string, string | number>): string;
    icon(name: string): string;
    formatDate(value: string): string;
    readonly sample: "zh" | "en" | "mixed";
}

export type PluginDistributionVerifier = (release: {
    pluginId: string;
    version: number;
    runtimeScope: 'project' | 'home';
    publisherKeyId: string;
}, signedPackage: unknown, files: ReadonlyMap<string, Uint8Array>) => void;

export interface PluginRegistration {
    readonly sync?: Readonly<Record<string, import('./plugin-sync-registration.js').BuiltinSyncBinding>>;
    readonly project_plugin_id: string;
    readonly catalog_order: number;
    readonly manifest: PluginManifest;
    readonly personal?: true;
    readonly default_enabled?: true;
    readonly companions?: readonly string[];
    readonly runtime?: {
        readonly create: () => PluginDefinition;
        readonly package_name: string;
        readonly factory_export: string;
        readonly keys?: string;
        readonly dual_instance?: true;
    };
    readonly project_runtime?: {
        readonly create: () => PluginDefinition;
        readonly package_name: string;
        readonly factory_export: string;
    };
    readonly home_store?: HomeStoreDeclaration;
    readonly workbench: PluginWorkbenchRegistration;
}

export interface PluginSearchRow {
    readonly selector: string;
    readonly idDataset: string;
}

export interface PluginWorkbenchRegistration {
    readonly pageRequests?: readonly {
        readonly method: string;
        readonly path: string;
    }[];
    readonly order: number;
    readonly contributions: readonly UiContribution[];
    readonly stylesheet?: string;
    readonly stylesheetLayer?: "over-shell" | "beneath-shell";
    readonly stylesheetShared?: readonly string[];
    readonly stylesheetPrefixes?: readonly string[];
    readonly stylesheetUses?: readonly string[];
    readonly clientFactory?: string;
    readonly clientMounts?: "surfaces";
    readonly clientServed?: true;
    readonly clientUses?: readonly string[];
    readonly clientAssets?: readonly string[];
    readonly settingsClient?: string;
    readonly settingsStylesheet?: string;
    readonly pageClients?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    readonly searchRow?: PluginSearchRow;
    readonly recordRow?: PluginSearchRow;
    readonly specimens?: (ports: PluginBoardSpecimenPorts) => readonly PluginBoardSpecimen[];
}

export type ProjectSyncContentOwner = string | {
    create(services: ProjectSyncServices): import('./sync-transport.js').ProjectReplicaDefinition;
    prepareUpload?(db: ReplicaDatabase, context: ProjectSyncUploadContext): Promise<void>;
};

export interface ProjectSyncServices {
    validateSavedHistory(json: string): {
        sessionId: string;
    };
}

export interface ProjectSyncUploadContext extends ProjectSyncServices {
    readonly projectId: string;
    authorize(): void;
    readSavedHistory(runtimeSessionId: string): Promise<string>;
}

export interface ReplicaDatabase {
    exec(sql: string): unknown;
    prepare(sql: string): {
        get(...params: SQLInputValue[]): Record<string, SQLOutputValue> | undefined;
        all(...params: SQLInputValue[]): Record<string, SQLOutputValue>[];
        run(...params: SQLInputValue[]): unknown;
    };
}

export interface SyncDocumentStorage {
    read(): string | null;
    compareAndSet(expected: string | null, value: string): boolean;
    compareAndSetChecked?(expected: string | null, value: string, validate: () => void): boolean;
    withReadLock?<R>(read: (current: string | null) => R): R;
}

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

type SQLInputValue = null | number | bigint | string | NodeJS.ArrayBufferView;

type SQLOutputValue = null | number | bigint | string | Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;
